Homepage og:title 'AKIRA Clothing | Top Trending Fashion Clothing and Shoes'; meta description 'Shop AKIRA for the best fashion online and in stores. Find the latest trends in sexy dresses, shoes, coats and more.' known_for from the og:title. meta.json: shop 'AKIRA', Chicago, Illinois, US, USD.

Shipping policy: free standard US shipping on orders of $75 or more, excluding sale items (before tax), within the 48 contiguous states; $7.95 under the threshold; standard 5–10 business days; 2-day from $20, overnight from $30; banner says expedited shipping is temporarily unavailable and processing is delayed 3+ business days. International via Global-e, 2–7 business days, duties collected by Global-e. The policy's country list names Canada and Australia but not the United Kingdom, although meta.json ships_to_countries includes GB; GB left out of ships_to.

Refund policy: online orders returnable within 30 days of the order date for a refund to the original payment or store credit, less original shipping; prepaid label costs $10 (deducted), free if you use your own label; final sale: earrings, tights, swimwear, face covers, body tape. In-store: full-price items within 14 days for exchange or store gift card only, no cash refunds; accessories, jewelry and bodysuits final sale in store.

Size guide: apparel XS (00–0), S (2–4), M (6–8), L (10–12), XL (14–16), 1X (18–20), 2X (22–24), 3X (26–28); denim sizes 1–19 (waist 24–36 in.). Models wear a small, size 2–4. Navigation has an Extended Sizes section (tops, bottoms, dresses, jackets) and Extended Size Shoes.
